query:
UPDATE formulations
             SET is_active  = COALESCE($1, is_active),
                 note       = COALESCE($2, note),
                 batch_qty  = COALESCE($3, batch_qty),
                 batch_unit = COALESCE($4, batch_unit),
                 procedures = COALESCE($5, procedures)
             WHERE id = $6
